cohort: 19,833 Chinese infants aged 14 days to 6 months
finding: Family history of DDH, breech presentation, oligohydramnios, musculoskeletal deformities, and female sex are high-risk factors for DDH in Chinese infants.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in developmental dysplasia of the hip incidence between infants delivered via cesarean section and those delivered vaginally.
